integrity: The proof reduces every one-variable sentence to an elementary condition on k=|p| inside an n-element universe, compresses an arbitrary theory to one strongest lower and one strongest upper bound, and checks all 25 bound pairs symbolically. The recent primary paper was inspected at its syntax and semantics, full spectrum theorem, characteristic-theory construction, and discussion of how lower bounds are generated from many differently sized nouns. Targeted literature and published-finding searches did not locate a one-variable spectrum classification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns exactly one raw variable in the original finite-model language. It does not classify fixed vocabularies of size two or more and does not cover Jiang's sentence-level Boolean extension.
title: The one-variable cardinality syllogistic has exactly five finite spectra
